title: Signal: TLS verification disabled in the Yarn configuration
scope: A .yarnrc file that declares a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false.
limitations: It matches a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false in the parsed .yarnrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .yarnrc that mentions a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
